name: Zhejiang Youpon Integrated Ceiling Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Youpon Integrated Ceiling Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of integrated ceilings in China. The company offers suspended ceiling; kitchen and bathroom appliances; clothes drying rack, smart lighting; system wall panels and hang on the wall, multifunctional, and other cabinet types. It also manufactures and sells lightweight building materials; plastic products; building decoration materials; engineered wood products; daily-use wood products; cork products; household appliances; lighting fixtures; home furnishing; doors and windows; furnitures; and new building materials.
